name: nasa-ads
description: Search the NASA Astrophysics Data System from Claude: papers, abstracts, citation metrics, BibTeX export, and your ADS libraries.
long_description: Gives Claude access to the NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) with your own ADS token: search papers, read abstracts, get citation and read metrics for papers and authors, export BibTeX exactly as ADS formats it, and list, create, and add to your ADS libraries. The server runs on your computer and talks only to the ADS API. A human-AI collaboration by Paula Coelho and Claude (Anthropic).

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search NASA ADS with full ADS query syntax. Results show title, authors, year, citations, journal, volume, page, DOI and arXiv ID, with paging and an optional collection filter.

tools.name: get_paper_details
tools.description: Get abstracts and full details for up to 20 papers at once, by bibcode, DOI or arXiv ID.

tools.name: get_author_papers
tools.description: Find papers by an author, in the astronomy collection by default, optionally narrowed by ORCID or affiliation. The result states any filter.

tools.name: export_bibtex
tools.description: Export BibTeX exactly as ADS formats it (journal macros, volume, pages, DOI, eprint), by bibcode, DOI or arXiv ID.

tools.name: get_paper_metrics
tools.description: Get citation, read and impact metrics for papers, by bibcode, DOI or arXiv ID.

tools.name: get_author_metrics
tools.description: Get an author's h-index, citations and other metrics, in the astronomy collection by default, optionally narrowed by ORCID or affiliation. The result states any filter.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List all your personal paper libraries/collections in ADS. Shows library names, descriptions, and paper counts.

tools.name: get_library_papers
tools.description: Get all papers from a specific library. Returns paper details for papers in the specified collection.

tools.name: create_library
tools.description: Create a new paper library/collection in the user's ADS account. Useful for organizing papers by topic, project, or reading status.

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Add papers to an existing library in the user's ADS account. Provide library ID and list of bibcodes to add. Papers already in the library are not duplicated.
